_comment: The browser chat AIs 'Use a browser AI' knows (D-5): small data adjustments (where to open, how much text a chat takes pasted, whether it can make files), never separate prompts. Read by npdev_relay_targets.py; the Manager draws its 'Open <name>' buttons from it and never holds a URL of its own. Every number is a CONSERVATIVE PLACEHOLDER until the owner's calibration run (a row in the calibration log behind it) flips 'calibrated' to true for that target. A target marked verifyUrl has a URL a human must open once before it is trusted (products move). Google AI Mode is a Search feature, NOT the Gemini app: a separate target, expected weaker for long structured output. 'label' is English; 'labels' holds the other languages by Manager language id.

targets.label: ChatGPT
targets.notes: Long pastes become an attachment chip automatically (fine). Code-interpreter may offer sandbox:/mnt/data links -> FILE_LINK_ONLY.

targets.label: Gemini
targets.notes: May move long output into Canvas -> answer text lacks the files (NO_FILES with mentions-artifact).

targets.label: Claude
targets.notes: Long pastes become an attachment (fine). May put files in an artifact panel -> same handling as canvas.

targets.label: Google AI Mode
targets.notes: Search product; input box and answer length expected to be the tightest. If round 1 does not fit, the profile switches to delivery=attachment or the UI shows 'works with limits, prefer Gemini'.
